title: Toolkit used on partner's real dataset; cleaned/validated/de-identified output accepted and used
context: This is the closed loop and the actual deed: the toolkit is used on a partner's real dataset and the cleaned/validated/de-identified output is formally accepted and used by the partner, satisfying Definition of Shipped. Reproducibility is independently verified, provenance is published, and conservation-expert sign-off is recorded where sensitive taxa are present. Zero PII or finer-than-permitted sensitive coordinates may appear in the delivered output. Depends on csp-partner-015 and csp-pipeline-014.
objective: Use the toolkit on the partner's real dataset and have the cleaned/validated/de-identified output formally accepted and used, with reproducibility independently verified, provenance published, and expert sign-off recorded where sensitive taxa are present.
acceptanceCriteria: The cleaned/validated/de-identified output is formally accepted and used by the partner
Reproducibility independently verified; provenance published; sensitive-handling expert sign-off recorded where sensitive taxa present; before/after error reduction recorded
Zero PII / finer-than-permitted sensitive coordinates in the delivered output
Definition of Shipped met: real project, real dataset, output accepted and used
output: /output/partner-handoff-016/ containing the delivered cleaned/validated/de-identified output, the published provenance manifest, the partner acceptance record, and the recorded expert sign-off where applicable.
outputLicense: Follows partner source dataset license; recorded per delivery
